# langsmith_agent (Data Source)

Reads an existing agent and its environments by agent ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "langsmith_agent" "example" {
  agent_id = "example"

  # Omit to use the workspace configured on the provider.
  workspace_id = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `agent_id` (String) Exact public agent ID, not its display name.

### Optional

- `workspace_id` (String) Workspace override. When omitted, uses the provider workspace.

### Read-Only

- `agent_type` (String) Agent classification.
- `created_at` (String) Agent creation timestamp.
- `environments` (Map of Object) Visible environments keyed by LOCAL, DEVELOPMENT, STAGING, or PRODUCTION. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--environments))
- `id` (String) Public agent ID.
- `name` (String) Display name.
- `owner_id` (String) Owner user ID, when present.
- `source_type` (String) Runtime kind.

<a id="nestedatt--environments"></a>
### Nested Schema for `environments`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String)
- `tracer_session_id` (String)
- `tracer_session_name` (String)
